cues.en: Hi, in this video I'm going to go into more details on the Model Context Protocol, and in this video specifically about dynamic on-the-fly tools.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支影片會進一步介紹 Model Context Protocol，主題是執行時動態調整的工具。

cues.en: So let's jump into some code where we don't have dynamic tools so far, but we'll put a few things in so they become dynamic.
cues.zh: 直接看程式碼。目前還沒有動態工具，接下來會加入一些設定，讓它們能動態改變。

cues.en: So in this sample, which is the remote server dynamic tools down here, I just have a normal MCP server, so we have the builder.addMCPServer
cues.zh: 這裡的 Remote Server Dynamic Tools 範例，目前只是一般 MCP 伺服器。我們呼叫 AddMcpServer，

cues.en: with HTTP to port, so it's a remote server with tools from assembly, and then we map MCP.
cues.zh: 使用 HTTP 傳輸，因此是遠端伺服器，再從組件載入工具，最後呼叫 MapMcp。

cues.en: So the absolute minimum you can do, and in here I have three tools, one called tool1, one called tool2, and admin tool1.
cues.zh: 這就是最基本的設定。裡面有三個工具：tool1、tool2，以及 adminTool1。

cues.en: And I've just put in the names in some constants in a file here,
cues.zh: 我在另一個檔案中，以常數集中存放它們的名稱，

cues.en: and I put in which of the tools are admin tools.
cues.zh: 並註記哪些是管理員工具。

cues.en: So if I connect to this, for example via Insomnia, and do the connection,
cues.zh: 例如透過 Insomnia 連線，

cues.en: we can see that we get three tools back, so I can call all three tools,
cues.zh: 可以看到回傳了三個工具，因此三個都能呼叫。

cues.en: and when I call tool1, I get a tool1 output, tool2, and get a tool2 output, and admin tool number 3.
cues.zh: 呼叫 tool1 會取得 tool1 的輸出，tool2 取得 tool2 的輸出，也能呼叫第三個管理員工具。

cues.en: So that's good and well, but in order for us to say we might want to have certain users to have just tool number 1 and 2, the normal tools,
cues.zh: 目前都沒問題，但我們可能希望某些使用者只能取得工具一與工具二，也就是一般工具，

cues.en: and a user with more privileges to have the admin tools as well.
cues.zh: 而具有更高權限的使用者，也可以取得管理員工具。

cues.en: So how do we go about doing that?
cues.zh: 應該如何實作呢？

cues.en: Well, the first thing we need to do is, of course, we need to have some kind of authentication.
cues.zh: 首先，當然需要某種驗證機制。

cues.en: So in here, we normally put in the builders here, add endpoint filters, or some of the other ways that you have seen in the previous videos
cues.zh: 通常會在這裡加入端點篩選器，或使用前面影片介紹過的其他

cues.en: about authentication.
cues.zh: 驗證方式。

cues.en: But in this case, I'm just going to put in an endpoint filter that have two valid keys, either a normal API key,
cues.zh: 不過這個例子只加入一個端點篩選器，接受兩個有效金鑰：一般 API 金鑰，

cues.en: which is just normal password in real life, it would be some kind of grid or something, and an admin key.
cues.zh: 這裡只是一般密碼，實際上應該使用 GUID 之類的值；另一個則是管理員金鑰。

cues.en: And if none of the two are the keys, we just get an unauthorized,
cues.zh: 如果提供的金鑰兩者都不符，就回傳 Unauthorized，

cues.en: else we get access to the MCP server.
cues.zh: 否則就可以存取 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: So if we go restart the code, now if we look at Auth, and I can see we use the normal password, we are logged in,
cues.zh: 重新啟動程式，看看驗證設定。這裡使用一般密碼，已經可以登入，

cues.en: but we can still see the admin tool, we haven't done anything about that yet.
cues.zh: 但仍然看得到管理員工具，因為我們還沒有處理工具權限。

cues.en: Or if we take the admin password, we of course also can log in, and in this case we should of course get all the tools,
cues.zh: 如果換成管理員密碼，當然也能登入，這種情況應該取得全部工具。

cues.en: but if we put something in that is not correct, we get an error message, unauthorized here.
cues.zh: 但若填入錯誤的值，就會收到這裡的 Unauthorized 錯誤。

cues.en: So authentication is up and running in a simple manner.
cues.zh: 簡單的驗證機制已經可以運作。

cues.en: But now we need to take that some of the tools should be there, and some of them should not be there.
cues.zh: 接下來要決定哪些工具應該顯示，哪些不應該顯示。

cues.en: It is possible to use the authentication attribute if you use OAuth and stuff like that, but in my case I want to show you that you can control
cues.zh: 如果使用 OAuth 等機制，可以運用驗證屬性。不過這裡想示範的是，你可以透過加入額外設定，

cues.en: every single little thing about what goes into the tools by adding some extra things up here.
cues.zh: 完全控制對外提供的工具清單。

cues.en: Because we can put in something called request filters.
cues.zh: 因為我們可以加入 Request Filters，也就是請求篩選器。

cues.en: And let me just grab the first request filter that we are going to put in, and then we will talk about it.
cues.zh: 先把第一個需要的請求篩選器加進來，再解釋它的作用。

cues.en: So I just add one more with here.
cues.zh: 在這裡再接上一個 With 呼叫。

cues.en: So I say I want request filters, meaning I want to filter what happens in the MCP server.
cues.zh: 指定使用請求篩選器，表示要篩選 MCP 伺服器中發生的操作。

cues.en: And what I can do, I have a filter builder here, and I can add various filters for listing of tools, calling of tools, similar for resources,
cues.zh: 這裡有 Filter Builder，可以分別加入列出工具、呼叫工具，以及資源等

cues.en: and the various things MCP servers can do.
cues.zh: MCP 伺服器所支援操作的篩選器。

cues.en: In this case we are only going to do anything with tools.
cues.zh: 這個範例只處理工具。

cues.en: So tools is essentially two things in an MCP server.
cues.zh: 在 MCP 伺服器中，工具主要有兩種操作，

cues.en: It's the listing of the tools, and it's the calling of the tools.
cues.zh: 也就是列出工具，以及呼叫工具。

cues.en: So what we're doing here is we're going to set a filter on the listing of the tools.
cues.zh: 現在要先針對列出工具設定篩選器。

cues.en: Because when we go here and log in with a normal user, we don't want to see this extra tool.
cues.zh: 因為使用一般帳號登入時，不應該看到這個額外的管理員工具。

cues.en: That would only confuse the AI using the MCP server.
cues.zh: 否則會讓使用 MCP 伺服器的 AI 感到困惑。

cues.en: Hey, there's a tool, but it's not allowed to call it.
cues.zh: 明明有工具，卻不允許呼叫。

cues.en: So we want to get rid of that tool on the fly, and right now we can't because we haven't put anything in.
cues.zh: 因此想在執行時移除這個工具。目前還做不到，因為還沒加入實作。

cues.en: But what we do is we get a normal next pattern, the middleware system of .NET,
cues.zh: 這裡採用一般的 next 模式，也就是 .NET 的中介軟體機制。

cues.en: and whenever we call this next, we actually get all the tools back.
cues.zh: 每次呼叫 next，就會取得全部工具。

cues.en: The best way to see this is probably to set some breakpoints.
cues.zh: 設定幾個中斷點，應該最容易看清楚。

cues.en: But before we go through it, let me talk about the code.
cues.zh: 不過在實際逐步執行之前，先解釋程式碼。

cues.en: So this will actually give us all the tools back that are registered in this system, meaning from this with two tools from assembly.
cues.zh: 這個呼叫會回傳系統內註冊的全部工具，也就是透過 WithToolsFromAssembly 載入的工具。

cues.en: But we need to check what is the user who are actually logged in.
cues.zh: 但我們需要檢查目前實際登入的是哪個使用者。

cues.en: And in order to do that, we use the HTTP context accessor.
cues.zh: 為此，要使用 IHttpContextAccessor。

cues.en: Because on the request, we can grab the iTech context accessor and get something about what the call has been about.
cues.zh: 因為可以透過 IHttpContextAccessor，取得目前這次請求的相關資訊。

cues.en: So in our case, we will use the HTTP context, get the request, and get the header.
cues.zh: 這裡先取得 HttpContext，再取得 Request，最後讀取標頭。

cues.en: Very similar to what we do down here, only here it's the real context already.
cues.zh: 這和下面的操作很相似，只是下面已經直接提供實際的 Context。

cues.en: Here we need this access contester before.
cues.zh: 這裡則需要先透過 Accessor 取得。

cues.en: And then if we get an API key, which we should, else we shouldn't have come here this far,
cues.zh: 接著讀取 API 金鑰。正常情況下應該存在，否則請求不應該走到這裡，

cues.en: but just the case, and if it's the admin key, then we just give all the tools back.
cues.zh: 但還是檢查一下。如果是管理員金鑰，就直接回傳全部工具。

cues.en: But if it's not the admin key, we want to go in and say all the tools that we have in the result, meaning all the ones that was found,
cues.zh: 如果不是管理員金鑰，就從結果中的全部工具，也就是剛剛找到的工具清單，

cues.en: only give back the ones that is not contained in the admin tools, meaning give back this tool, this tool, but not this tool.
cues.zh: 只回傳不包含在管理員工具清單中的項目，也就是這兩個工具，不回傳這個。

cues.en: And again, this is just a shop.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這只是一般 C# 程式碼。

cues.en: You could have that certain tools were only available in the start of the month or whatever you would figure out what to do.
cues.zh: 你也可以設定某些工具只有每月月初能使用，或加入任何你想要的條件。

cues.en: This is a bit cumbersome because it's just authentication, but you can do whatever you want in these add list filters.
cues.zh: 這裡因為只處理驗證，看起來有點繁瑣，但在列出工具的篩選器裡，可以做任何事情。

cues.en: So if we start the code again, try to do a connection to this one, and we can see now with a normal password,
cues.zh: 再次啟動程式，嘗試連線。現在使用一般密碼，

cues.en: we will hit this filter on the fly.
cues.zh: 就會在執行時命中這個篩選器。

cues.en: Because it doesn't run at startup, it runs on the fly because you might need to go down to a database to check what is the user's permissions and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 它不是在啟動時執行，而是在每次請求時執行，因為可能需要查詢資料庫，確認使用者權限等資訊。

cues.en: So everything can be done in here.
cues.zh: 這些操作都可以放在這裡處理。

cues.en: So we get our results, and our result makes sense.
cues.zh: 現在取得結果，內容也符合預期。

cues.en: We have our three tools, normal and admin tools.
cues.zh: 這裡有三個工具，包括一般與管理員工具。

cues.en: Then we grab the context assessor and the API key.
cues.zh: 接著取得 Context Accessor 與 API 金鑰。

cues.en: So we can see that our API key was the normal password, and since that is not the admin password, we are sent down here where we actually just take our tools,
cues.zh: 可以看到目前金鑰是一般密碼，而不是管理員密碼，因此程式走到這裡，從工具清單中，

cues.en: but only get the ones that are not admin tools, meaning two tools.
cues.zh: 只保留非管理員工具，也就是兩個工具。

cues.en: And if we do this, we can now see that I've logged in, but only with those two tools.
cues.zh: 繼續執行，就能看到已經登入，但只能取得那兩個工具。

cues.en: Let's get rid of the breakpoints, and try to log in as the admin user instead.
cues.zh: 移除中斷點，改用管理員身分登入看看。

cues.en: If we do that, we get the third tool back.
cues.zh: 這樣就取得第三個工具了。

cues.en: Because in that case, we hit this if statement, it was true, so we just gave all the tools back.
cues.zh: 因為這次 if 條件成立，所以直接回傳全部工具。

cues.en: So some of you might think now, okay, now we're done, it's okay.
cues.zh: 你可能會想，好了，這樣應該完成了吧？

cues.en: But actually, this is just the listing of the tools.
cues.zh: 但實際上，這裡只是控制列出的工具清單。

cues.en: And most MCP servers would never be able to call a tool that hasn't listed, but you can technically do it if you begin to write code.
cues.zh: 大多數 MCP 用戶端不會呼叫未列出的工具，但如果自行撰寫程式，技術上仍然做得到。

cues.en: So this is not enough to secure this system.
cues.zh: 因此，單靠這樣還不足以保護系統。

cues.en: We need to make sure that this tool cannot be called, even if it's not even listed in the system.
cues.zh: 必須確保，即使工具沒有列在清單中，沒有權限的人也無法呼叫它。

cues.en: So for that, we need one more builder.
cues.zh: 為此，需要再加入一個設定。

cues.en: So let me bring in the last filter we need.
cues.zh: 先把最後一個需要的篩選器加進來。

cues.en: And that should be in here.
cues.zh: 應該放在這裡。

cues.en: So we also add a filter for the add tool call filter.
cues.zh: 也就是再加入 AddCallToolFilter，處理工具呼叫。

cues.en: And in this case, we just say if the tool that we call inside MCP, they are called match primitives,
cues.zh: 這裡會檢查正在呼叫的工具。MCP 內部會把它稱為 Matched Primitive，

cues.en: this is the common word for resources, tools, and so on.
cues.zh: 這是資源、工具等項目的共用稱呼。

cues.en: So if it's an admin tool that we're calling, then we need to double-check that we can actually allow to call it,
cues.zh: 如果呼叫的是管理員工具，就需要再次確認是否真的有權限，

cues.en: else we can just do the normal await next.
cues.zh: 否則就直接照一般方式 await next。

cues.en: And in here, we do exactly the same, we just get what the given API key was for the call, and check if we are admin.
cues.zh: 這裡的做法完全相同：取得呼叫時提供的 API 金鑰，再檢查是否為管理員。

cues.en: And if we are not admin, we throw an exception that we are not allowed to call this tool.
cues.zh: 如果不是管理員，就拋出例外，表示不允許呼叫這個工具。

cues.en: So right now, I can't really show you this, unless I actually take away the filter, because Insomnia that I use for the testing of the MCPs
cues.zh: 目前要示範這件事，必須先移除工具清單篩選器，因為我拿來測試 MCP 的 Insomnia，

cues.en: will not be able to.
cues.zh: 無法呼叫未列出的工具。

cues.en: But if I do it like this, and add a breakpoint here,
cues.zh: 所以先這樣修改，再在這裡加入中斷點。

cues.en: we can now go in, disconnect, log in as a normal user.
cues.zh: 接著中斷連線，使用一般帳號重新登入。

cues.en: And a normal user in this case will get all tools, because we just removed the list part filtering.
cues.zh: 由於剛剛移除了列出工具時的篩選，一般使用者現在也會取得全部工具。

cues.en: So we could have access to this tool, and when we call it, again, the filters will be hit.
cues.zh: 因此能看到這個工具。呼叫時，一樣會命中篩選器。

cues.en: This tool we can see is the admin tool I called.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我呼叫的就是管理員工具。

cues.en: I will check, I put in the normal password.
cues.zh: 接著檢查，提供的是一般密碼。

cues.en: Am I an admin? No.
cues.zh: 目前是管理員嗎？不是。

cues.en: Then we are not allowed to call the tool.
cues.zh: 所以不允許呼叫工具。

cues.en: Meaning, back here, we get we are not allowed to call that tool.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，就會收到不允許呼叫該工具的錯誤。

cues.en: If I put in the admin instead,
cues.zh: 如果改成管理員金鑰，

cues.en: and call the tool,
cues.zh: 再呼叫工具，

cues.en: we see the admin password, we are admin, so we allow it.
cues.zh: 可以看到現在是管理員密碼，因此允許呼叫。

cues.en: And of course, if we just call one of the normal tools, we will not even go into this section where we check, because it's just one of the tools everyone is allowed to call.
cues.zh: 當然，如果只是呼叫一般工具，就不會進入這段權限檢查，因為那是所有人都能使用的工具。

cues.en: So, in summary, if we put this back in, this is how you will see the sample up in GitHub.
cues.zh: 總結一下，把這一段放回來後，就是 GitHub 上範例的完整形式。

cues.en: We add this request filters, and again, we can do all kinds of things here.
cues.zh: 我們加入請求篩選器，而且如前面所說，這裡可以處理各種條件。

cues.en: We could make a tool only visible on Fridays for some reason, or whatever we want to do, we can go down to a database,
cues.zh: 例如因為某種需求，只讓工具在星期五顯示，或是查詢資料庫，

cues.en: check if we have access or not, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 確認有沒有存取權限等等。

cues.en: And if we do that, and we then call our tool, if there's a way we get around this, we still lock the user.
cues.zh: 就算有人想繞過工具清單限制，直接呼叫工具，這裡仍然會阻擋沒有權限的使用者。

cues.en: And in order to get authentication in the first place, we just add the endpoint filter,
cues.zh: 至於最前面的身分驗證，只要加入端點篩選器，

cues.en: or one of the other ones from the previous videos on how to do authentication for an MCP.
cues.zh: 或採用前面影片介紹的其他 MCP 驗證方式即可。

cues.en: So, this is how you can make dynamic tool calls, and on the fly say, some users have these tools, some users have these tools, depending on what they want.
cues.zh: 這就是動態工具的做法：在執行時依需求決定，有些使用者取得這一組工具，另一些使用者取得另一組。

cues.en: Because now I'm doing it with a user that needs to have various credentials, but it could also be that you want to have an MCP server
cues.zh: 這裡使用使用者認證作為條件，但也可能是想建立一個 MCP 伺服器，

cues.en: where the user in their configuration of the MCP server should be able to say, I want these tools, I don't want these tools, I'm this type of user, only give these tools back.
cues.zh: 讓使用者在設定中選擇：我要這些工具、不要那些工具，或是依照使用者類型，只回傳特定工具。

cues.en: So, that's the reason why, when we have normal C Sharp code here, where we can do anything, we have full control over what tools to go.
cues.zh: 因為這裡就是一般 C# 程式碼，可以實作任何邏輯，因此能完全掌控提供哪些工具。

cues.en: So, that's everything. See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些，下一支影片見。
